About.title: About
About.paragraph1: FuyouAI turns ambiguous requirements into stable, automated workflows. We focus on task understanding, structured breakdown, and execution-ready outputs.
About.paragraph2: Our goal is to help teams ship consistent results faster, with reusable task templates and reliable execution paths.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.paragraph1: We value your privacy and are committed to handling your data in a transparent and responsible manner. This Privacy Policy explains how information is collected and used when you access or use our SaaS service.
Privacy.paragraph2: We collect limited personal information, including your email address and basic usage data (such as system interactions and feature usage). This data is collected solely to provide, operate, maintain, and improve the service, manage user accounts, and respond to support requests.
Privacy.paragraph3: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes. Your data is used only as necessary to deliver the service and comply with applicable legal obligations.
Privacy.paragraph4: You may contact us at any time if you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled by emailing admin@fuyouai.com.

Terms.paragraph1: By accessing or using the Fuyou AI platform, you agree to these Terms of Service.
Terms.paragraph2: Fuyou AI provides subscription-based access to AI-assisted system features through an online platform. An active subscription is required to access paid features. Subscriptions are billed monthly only, and annual plans are not offered.
Terms.paragraph3: You agree to use the service in a lawful and reasonable manner and not to misuse, disrupt, or attempt unauthorized access to the system.
Terms.paragraph4: The service is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. To the maximum extent permitted by law, Fuyou AI is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of the service.
Terms.paragraph5: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access if these terms are violated or if required for legal or operational reasons. You may stop using the service at any time by discontinuing your subscription.
Terms.paragraph6: For questions regarding these terms, please contact:

Refund.title: Refund Policy
Refund.paragraph1: Fuyou AI operates as a subscription-based SaaS platform.
Refund.paragraph2: Subscription fees are billed in advance for the selected billing period on a monthly basis. Annual plans or custom yearly billing are not available.
Refund.paragraph3: Because access to digital services and system resources is provided immediately upon purchase, payments are generally non-refundable.
Refund.paragraph4: If you believe a billing error has occurred or experience technical issues preventing normal use of the service, you may contact us within 7 days of the charge date.
Refund.paragraph5: Refund requests are reviewed on a case-by-case basis in accordance with applicable consumer protection laws.
